newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$9 bln in funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$9 bln in funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Friday injected T$9 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations, a bank official said.

The bank, operating through finance companies authorised to issue commercial paper, bought T$9 billion in approved securities instruments offered by financial institutions with yield at between 6.250 and 6.625 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments between seven and 11 days from now, the official said.
